about_zh: 攻防、逆向、加密与隐私保护。

repos.description: Reverse Engineering / Authorized Penetration Testing / Security Research Skill Router Pack AI-powered routing + On-demand toolchain bootstrapping + Self-evolving knowledge base  Supports Claude Code, Kiro, Cursor, Cline, and other AI coding clients 逆向/渗透/安全技能路由包 - AI 自动路由 + 按需自举工具链 + 自动进化经验库 | 支持 Claude Code / Kiro / Cursor / Cline 等代码 AI 客户端
repos.summary_zh: 面向逆向工程、授权渗透测试与安全研究的 AI 技能路由包，提供智能任务分发、按需工具链自举与自进化经验库，支持 Windows/Linux/macOS/Kali 多平台，兼容 Claude Code、Kiro、Cursor、Cline 等主流 AI 编程客户端。
repos.summary_en: An AI-powered skill router for reverse engineering, authorized penetration testing, and security research. It provides intelligent task routing, on-demand toolchain bootstrapping, and a self-evolving knowledge base across Windows/Linux/macOS/Kali, compatible with Claude Code, Kiro, Cursor, Cline and other AI coding clients.

repos.description: ⚡️A native, local-first alternative to Logitech Options+, written in Rust 🦀 — remap buttons, DPI, and SmartShift over HID++. No account, no telemetry.
repos.summary_zh: OpenLogi 是一款用 Rust 编写的本地优先、原生替代 Logitech Options+ 的工具，无需账户或遥测，通过 HID++ 协议直接控制罗技鼠标的按键映射、DPI 和 SmartShift。支持 macOS，提供 GUI 和 CLI 双模式，配置为纯 TOML 文件，强调隐私与离线使用。
repos.summary_en: OpenLogi is a native, local-first alternative to Logitech Options+, written in Rust — remap buttons, DPI, and SmartShift over HID++. No account, no telemetry. Supports macOS with GUI and CLI, plain TOML config, privacy-focused and offline-first.

repos.description: Claude Code skill to support Android app's reverse engineering
repos.summary_zh: 专为 Claude Code 设计的 Android 逆向工程技能，可对 APK/XAPK/JAR/AAR 进行反编译并提取 HTTP API（Retrofit、OkHttp、Ktor、Apollo GraphQL）。支持 Kotlin/KMP 应用的 R8 混淆还原、框架识别与调用链追踪，助力 API 文档化与安全研究。
repos.summary_en: A Claude Code skill for Android reverse engineering that decompiles APK/XAPK/JAR/AAR files and extracts HTTP APIs (Retrofit, OkHttp, Ktor, Apollo GraphQL). Supports R8 deobfuscation for Kotlin/KMP apps, framework detection, and call flow tracing for security research and API documentation.

repos.description: Bananas🍌, Cross-Platform screen 🖥️ sharing 📡 made simple ⚡.
repos.summary_zh: Bananas 是一款跨平台屏幕共享工具，支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux，采用点对点连接技术，无需注册或服务器中转（仅需 STUN/TURN 和信令服务器完成初始连接）。主打隐私安全、简单易用，适合快速分享屏幕。
repos.summary_en: Bananas is a cross-platform screen sharing tool for Mac, Windows, and Linux, using peer-to-peer connections without requiring accounts or central servers (except for STUN/TURN and signaling servers). It emphasizes privacy, simplicity, and instant sharing.

repos.summary_zh: Remodex 是一款本地优先的开源桥接工具，结合 iOS 应用与 macOS 后台服务，实现 iPhone 对 OpenAI Codex 的远程控制。支持端到端加密配对、实时流式交互、Git 操作、子智能体调用及结构化规划模式，提供低延迟响应与细粒度访问控制，全程无需依赖公共服务器。
repos.summary_en: Remodex is a local-first open-source bridge with an iOS app that enables remote control of OpenAI Codex from your iPhone. It features end-to-end encrypted pairing, real-time streaming, Git actions, subagents, planning mode, and secure access controls—all running on-device without relying on public endpoints.

repos.summary_zh: QiuChenly CoreInject 是一个集成化逆向工程与IPA注入工具，主打一键破解与自动化脚本分发。其核心是 QiuChenly AppStore，将破解库、脚本、社区交流统一封装为跨平台桌面应用，支持macOS系统，提供预破解包上传与管理后台，构建去中心化的自由软件生态。
repos.summary_en: QiuChenly CoreInject is an integrated reverse engineering and IPA injection tool, focusing on one-click cracking and automated script distribution. Its core is the QiuChenly AppStore, which unifies cracked libraries, scripts, and community sharing into a cross-platform desktop app for macOS, offering pre-cracked package uploads and admin backends to build a decentralized free software ecosystem.

repos.description: Authenticator on Windows for Battle.net / Steam / Guild Wars 2 / Glyph / Runescape / SWTOR / Bitcoin and digital currency exchanges
repos.summary_zh: WinAuth 是一款开源的 Windows 多平台双因子认证工具，支持 RFC 6238 时间型（TOTP）和 HOTP 计数器型验证码，兼容 Battle.net、Steam、Guild Wars 2、SWTOR 及主流数字货币交易所。具备密码保护、机器绑定、YubiKey 支持、热键操作、便携模式及跨设备导入导出功能，适用于安全与便捷的双重认证管理。
repos.summary_en: WinAuth is an open-source, portable authenticator for Windows that supports RFC 6238 (TOTP) and HOTP-based 2FA codes. It integrates authenticators for Battle.net, Steam, Guild Wars 2, SWTOR, and major cryptocurrency exchanges like Coinbase and Bitstamp. Features include password protection, machine binding, YubiKey support, hotkey controls, portable mode, and import/export via UriKeyFormat, enabling secure and unified two-factor authentication management.
